title: Fangchinoline alleviates hypertensive heart failure via PGC-1alpha/STAT6/PPARgamma activation of mitophagy against ferroptosis.
authors: Liu, Chang; Wang, Zhuoqun; Zhang, Linxin; Yang, Di; Zhang, Zhihong; Cui, Xiaoli; Eid, Ali H; Wang, Mengyang
one_liner_zh: 该文研究药物Fangchinoline通过PGC-1alpha/STAT6/PPARgamma通路缓解高血压心力衰竭，核心是心肌细胞线粒体自噬与铁死亡，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND AND PURPOSE: Fangchinoline (FAN), a bioactive bisbenzylisoquinoline alkaloid from Stephania tetrandra, shows protective potential against angiotensin II (Ang II)-induced hypertensive heart failure (HF), particularly involving mitophagy and ferroptosis, remain unclear. We investigated the effects of FAN on Ang II-induced cardiac remodelling and HF. Experimental Approach A hypertensive heart failure model was established in C57BL/6 mice via 4-week Ang II infusion. FAN was administered during the final 2 weeks. Cardiac function was assessed by echocardiography and pathological remodelling was evaluated by histological staining. RNA sequencing of cardiac tissue was performed to investigate the mechanism of anti-heart failure action of FAN. The potential binding proteins of FAN were verified by molecular docking, drug affinity response target stability (DARTS), cellular thermal shift assay (CETSA) and surface plasmon resonance assay (SPR). In vitro, neonatal rat ventricular myocytes (NRVMs) were used to investigate the effects of FAN on cellular hypertrophy, mitophagy and ferroptosis. KEY RESULTS: In vivo, FAN treatment significantly ameliorated cardiac hypertrophy, dysfunction and fibrosis. These protective effects were independent of blood pressure-lowering actions. Mechanistically, FAN activates PGC-1alpha to enhance mitophagy and suppress STAT6-PPARgamma signalling, thereby inhibiting ferroptosis and restoring redox homeostasis. In vitro, FAN reduced Ang II-induced NRVM hypertrophy, ROS production and mitochondrial membrane potential depolarisation, and confirmed the modulation of mitophagy and ferroptosis markers. CONCLUSIONS AND IMPLICATIONS: We demonstrate that FAN alleviates Ang II-induced HF through a mechanism involving the activation of PGC-1alpha-mediated mitophagy and regulation of the STAT6-PPARgamma pathway, ultimately suppressing cardiomyocyte ferroptosis. These results offer new perspectives for HF treatment.
abstract_zh: 背景与目的：防己诺林碱（FAN），一种来自粉防己（Stephania tetrandra）的生物活性双苄基异喹啉生物碱，对血管紧张素II（Ang II）诱导的高血压性心力衰竭（HF）显示出保护潜力，但涉及线粒体自噬（mitophagy）和铁死亡（ferroptosis）的具体机制尚不清楚。我们研究了FAN对Ang II诱导的心脏重构和HF的影响。实验方法：通过4周Ang II输注在C57BL/6小鼠中建立高血压性心力衰竭模型。FAN在最后2周给药。通过超声心动图评估心脏功能，并通过组织学染色评估病理重构。对心脏组织进行RNA测序以研究FAN抗心力衰竭作用的机制。通过分子对接、药物亲和响应靶标稳定性（DARTS）、细胞热位移分析（CETSA）和表面等离子体共振分析（SPR）验证FAN的潜在结合蛋白。体外实验中，使用新生大鼠心室肌细胞（NRVMs）研究FAN对细胞肥大、线粒体自噬和铁死亡的影响。主要结果：在体内，FAN治疗显著改善了心脏肥大、功能障碍和纤维化。这些保护作用与降血压作用无关。机制上，FAN激活PGC-1alpha以增强线粒体自噬并抑制STAT6-PPARgamma信号通路，从而抑制铁死亡并恢复氧化还原稳态。在体外，FAN减少了Ang II诱导的NRVM肥大、ROS产生和线粒体膜电位去极化，并确认了线粒体自噬和铁死亡标志物的调节。结论与意义：我们证明FAN通过涉及激活PGC-1alpha介导的线粒体自噬和调节STAT6-PPARgamma通路的机制缓解Ang II诱导的HF，最终抑制心肌细胞铁死亡。这些结果为HF治疗提供了新视角。
